Postal-code boundaries: Statistics Canada 2021 forward sortation area (FSA) boundary file, simplified for speed. Rural codes over 1,000 km² are split into Alberta Township System blocks (W4, W5, W6). The township grid is calculated, so lines can sit a few hundred metres off the surveyed roads; check legal land descriptions before quoting them.
